content: Timotiga tokiyaage huka Anumaya Koti kea huhaleka huo.

Yisasi Kalaisia fali-mainaya veanene afaa mainaya veanene kaiyekema hulatesia yafeene Yisasia agaiama kava yagaigahema ikapinagati eteno elavisia yafeene Anumaya Koti aufiene Yisasi Kalaisi aufiene tokiyaage ke huna kahanepauve.

Kanale kanafiene havi kanafiene veamoya havisaya kanafiene ohavisaya kanafiene Anumayamo kea aluya huka kaula ofaeka huge huge huka hamapaiyo. Maigayetama maiho. Kefo kavama nehaya yamona anonaa aligahae. huka yuna kefiti vase huka hamapaiyo. Ani kavama hisana yafena kasalo okahaenageka mailava huka maineka kanale kea huhaleka hamapaiyo.

Nagi haenagaa veamoya kelamage kea ohavisaya amakesa haviya amakaveno huteteya amakaiami hamaisia kema havisaya yafe amakesa haga neneya kasagoya vayayaga kanale ohunea kema hamapaisaya yafe amavale-mainae. Aniama haya yafe menia kaula ofaeka aluya huka kanale keage hamapaiyo. amakaiamima hamaisia kema hisaya vayate alu vayamo ke alu vayamo ke haviya havigema haya amavagea havigahae.

Kagaya mukia kanafina kagu kagesale yagai lokiya vaika maiyo. Kana yama kagaipi falote hisigeka mailava huka maiyo. Yisasina kanale keama huhaleka hisana aliyana nealika mukia Anumaya Kotima kaminea aliyakaa mukia alivayayo.
Poloa mage hie Menia ago faligahe nehue. huno humaine.
Kagaya age-mainane nagaya Anumayamo aliya nealuanagiya nahaesageno kolania lavisigena ma mopa neatalena falina visua kania ago falote humaine.

Satanienena kanaleya huna ago tua hu-malenoe. Anumaya Koti naminea katela ago naiyage naiyage huna evayima huo hunoma humainelela ago evayi humainoe. Anumayamo aliya alina agai kema havina nagupi malena nametiti humainoa yania oatalenoe.

Oatalenoa yafe Anumaya Kotia kanale anona yania natene. Fatago huno kaiyeke hulatesia Anumayatimoa kaiyeke hulatesia kanafina Fatago kano mainane. huno hunateteno aliyamaa ali-mainoafe kanale anona yania namigahie. Ani anonaa nagainigela oaligahugi mukia veama Anumayamoa etenoma elavisia yafe muse nehuya agava nemaiya veanene ani anonaa aligahune.
Timotia aupaa Polote esie.
Kaiyayeka nakaitega aupaa eno.
Nago kanomo agia Timasie ma mopafi yafe haigeno nagaila nenataleno Tesalonaika kumate umaine. Nako kanomo agia Kalesenie Kalesia kotega vigeno Taitasia ania huno Talamesi kotega nataleno umaine.
Nago kanomo agia Lukue agaiage nagaienena maine. Makia kanaleya huno naya hugahigi kagaya avale-lineka eno.
Nagaya Tikikusina ago hutogeno Efasusi kumate umaine.
Nagaya yasi siotania Taloasi kumate Kapasi nopi atalena emainogi nealika avoniaene yagamo augafaleti talo hu-malenea avofena aluya huno nenahaigi alika me namio.
Haesa kapale aliya nealia kanomo agia Alekasatae nagaila nagia alino haviya hunateanagi Anumayamoa anima humainea kava huno agaila anona yamaa havi yana amigahie.
Aluya hutama agaifena kaye ho. Tagayama humainona kehena tusiya huno hai vai-mainea kano maine.

Ehema kaiyeke hunatageya nagoa veamoya naya hisaya yafe nagaienena hetiya omaiya natalagena nagainige heti-mainoe. Nagaima nataleya ufuma humainaya yafena Anumayamoa anonaamia havi yana oamamisie huna nunamupiti havinegoe.

Vayamoya nagaila natalayanagi Anumayamoa naya huno nagaiene hetino tokiyaa namigena mukia Yuta vea omainaya veamoya havilama huya havisaya yafene huna Anumayamo kea huhalena hugeya ani kaiyekema hunataya vayamoya kaveage afua laiyonimoma hia kava huya naugafa anitaga huya negahe hayanagi Anumaya Kotia naugafa aligati-maine.

Anumayamoa ani kava huno mukia havi kava hugahe haya yapitilagi nagaila nau nevaino nagu namena aligatiteno agaia ikapinaga kavama hu-mainelega navaleno nategahie. Ani yafe Anumayamo agia alisaga nehuta agai agigeya agola alisaga hume hume haisune. Tamage.
Kagaya Palisilaene Akuilaene Onesifolasina agaila nomaafi mainaya anagaaene nagainia hu falu fala kenia humato.
Nago nafanemo agia Elasatusie Kolini kumate atalogeno mainegeno Talofimasia kali aligena Mailitusi kumate atalena emainoe.

Kagaya havigu mainesanageno yasiage ikana evayi huyafenagi evayi ohunesigeka kaiyayeka ago eno. Mukia lafu-taganayaene Yupulusiene Putenisiene Linusiene Kolotiaene felugae huya hu fulu fala hunegatae.
Nagi Anumayamoa kagaila kagu kagesafi maineno kayone hutama maisaya yana tamamisie huna havinegoe.
